annotations.text:
OPTION A — Control board (recommended)

One scoreboard band absorbs the old page title, match header, hero score, target banner AND the four stat tiles. The three 248px portrait cards become a compact three-row crease rail, which frees enough width to sit both full scorecards side by side. Commentary is gone.

Tradeoff: dense. The tables carry the visual weight, so it reads more like a scoring console than a TV broadcast.

OPTION B — Focus rail

Keeps the TV-style portrait cards at full size, gives the chase equation its own gold band, and shows four complete over-by-over rows. All the numbers move to a narrow right rail.

Tradeoff: the scorecards are cramped — dismissal lines had to go, and a long batting card will need its own internal scroll sooner than in Option A.
